words.gloss: depletion of draught animals and men
words.gram: dvandva in tat-puruṣa, m. nom. sg.

hindi: जुए में जोतने योग्य पशुओं और पुरुषों की हानि क्षय है।
english: The depletion of draught animals and men is loss (kṣaya).
notes: yugya = "fit for the yoke"; rendered draught animals (could also include vehicles).

words.gram: dvandva in tat-puruṣa, m. nom. sg.

hindi: सोने और अन्न की हानि व्यय है।
english: The depletion of gold and grain is expenditure (vyaya).

hindi: उन दोनों से अनेक गुणों में बढ़कर लाभ होने पर प्रस्थान करे।
english: He should march when the gain is superior to those two by many advantages.
notes: tābhyām refers to kṣaya and vyaya of units 1-2 (the two are not named in the line).

hindi: आदेय, प्रत्यादेय, प्रसादक, प्रकोपक, ह्रस्वकाल, तनुक्षय, अल्पव्यय, महान्, वृद्धि-उदय, कल्य, धर्म्य और पुरोग — यह लाभ की सम्पत् है।
english: Acceptable (ādeya), retakable (pratyādeya), pacifying (prasādaka), provoking (prakopaka), of short duration, of slight loss, of little expenditure, great, of rising increase, sound, righteous and leading: this is the excellence of gain.
notes: A list of twelve qualities explained one by one in units 5-23. ādeya = "to be taken", pratyādeya = "liable to be taken back" (see unit 5, apratyādeya). vṛddhy-udaya could also be a dvandva "increase and rise"; kalya "sound/healthy" and puroga "going in front" are rendered literally. "ca-iti" is an unsandhied join in the e-text.
lines_deva: आदेयः प्रत्यादेयः प्रसादकः प्रकोपको ह्रस्व.कालस् तनु.क्षयो ऽल्प.व्ययो महान् वृद्ध्य्.उदयः कल्यो धर्म्यः पुरोगश् च-इति लाभ.सम्पत्
lines_iast: ādeyaḥ pratyādeyaḥ prasādakaḥ prakopako hrasva.kālas tanu.kṣayo 'lpa.vyayo mahān vṛddhy.udayaḥ kalyo dharmyaḥ purogaś ca-iti lābha.sampat

words.gram: dvandva of adjectives, m. nom. sg.

hindi: जो सरलता से प्राप्त हो, सँभाला जा सके और दूसरों के द्वारा वापस न लिया जा सके, वह आदेय है।
english: [A gain that is] easily obtained and kept, and not to be taken back by others, is acceptable (ādeya).
notes: "[A gain that is]" is supplied from context (lābha). "Easily" may apply only to suprāpya, with anupālya = "to be maintained"; rendered with "easily" over both. pareṣām apratyādeya: "not retakable by others" (genitive of the agent).

hindi: विपरीत होने पर प्रत्यादेय है।
english: In the opposite case [it is] retakable (pratyādeya).

words.gram: pres. part. ā-√dā, m. nom. sg.

hindi: उसे लेने वाला अथवा वहाँ ठहरने वाला विनाश को प्राप्त होता है।
english: Taking it, or staying there, he meets destruction.
notes: tam = the retakable gain of unit 6; tatrastha may mean staying in the place of the gain.
lines_deva: तम् आददानस् तत्रस्थो वा विनाशं प्राप्नोति
lines_iast: tam ādadānas tatrastho vā vināśaṃ prāpnoti

words.gloss: arrangements for the protection of treasury, army and stores
words.gram: dvandva in tat-puruṣa, n. acc. pl.

words.gloss: I shall cause to drain away
mines, materials, elephant forests, embankments, dams and trade routes

words.gram: as printed paraṃ (adv. "further"?); m. nom. sg. only if paraḥ is meant

hindi: अथवा यदि वह देखे: "वापस लिए जा सकने वाले लाभ को लेकर मैं कोश, दण्ड और संचय की रक्षा के प्रबन्धों को बहा दूँगा; खानों, सामग्रियों, हाथियों के वनों, सेतुओं, बाँधों और वणिक्-मार्गों को ऐसा कर दूँगा कि उनकी बहुमूल्य वस्तुएँ निकाल ली गई हों; इसकी प्रकृतियों को क्षीण करूँगा, उन्हें दूर हटवाऊँगा, अथवा आयोग से उन्हें प्रसन्न करूँगा; उन्हें दूसरा प्रतियोग से कुपित करेगा; अथवा इसके विरोधी पक्ष में इसे व्यापार की वस्तु बना दूँगा; अथवा इसे अपरुद्ध मित्र सौंपूँगा; यहीं रहते हुए मित्र के अथवा अपने देश की चोरों और शत्रुओं से होने वाली पीड़ा का प्रतिकार करूँगा; इसके मित्र अथवा आश्रय को विगुणता ग्रहण कराऊँगा; तब वह शत्रु से विरक्त, इसके कुल के व्यक्ति को स्वीकार करेगा; अथवा सत्कार करके इसे भूमि दूँगा; साथ संगठित होकर उठा हुआ मित्र मेरा चिरकाल तक रहेगा" वह वापस लिए जा सकने वाले लाभ को भी ले ले।
english: Or if he should see: "Having taken the retakable [gain], I shall cause the arrangements for the protection of the treasury, army and stores [of his] to drain away; I shall make [his] mines, materials, elephant forests, embankments, dams and trade routes with their valuables taken out; I shall weaken his constituent elements, I shall draw them away, or I shall win them over by āyoga; the other [party] will provoke them by pratiyoga; or I shall make him an article of trade in his rival side; or I shall present to him a shut-out (aparuddha) ally; staying here, I shall remedy the affliction of an ally's or of my own region from thieves and from enemies; I shall make his ally or his support grasp [his] defectiveness; then [he] will accept [one who is] estranged from the enemy [and] of his family; or, having honoured [him], I shall give him land — an ally united and risen together [with me] will be mine for a long time," he should take even a retakable gain.

text_flags.why: subject of kopayiṣyati expected in nominative; final ṃ for ḥ looks like a typing slip (possible)

notes: LOW-CERTAINTY LINE; a long quoted plan of 11 clauses. (1) param: read as "the other" (para, m. nom. sg.) subject of kopayiṣyati; alternatively the adverb "afterwards/but"; who "the other" is is not stated. (2) āyoga and pratiyoga are obscure here: kept as printed (literally "application/assignment" and "counter-application"); not glossed further. (3) pratipakṣe vā-asya paṇyam enaṃ kariṣyāmi: asya taken with pratipakṣe ("in his rival side"); enam = him; the persons are not named. (4) mitram aparuddhaṃ vā-asya pratipādayiṣyāmi: aparuddha rendered literally "shut out" (glossary 12.1 gives "in disfavour" for a prince); asya taken as "to him"; it could also be "his ally ... I shall hand over". (5) khani-dravya-hasti-vana-setu-bandha-vaṇik-pathān: grouping uncertain ("produce-forests and elephant forests" is possible). (6) grāhayiṣyāmi = causative of grah, "make him grasp/take up". (7) tad ... pratipatsyate: subject not stated (the ally/support?); amitra-virakta could be "estranged from the enemy" or "alienated by the enemy"; tat-kulīna = member of his family (glossary). (8) The first iti (after dāsyāmi) is internal and is rendered by a dash, the second closes the quotation and is not rendered. "[ones]" supplied. The e-text puts "-" in āyogena-ārādhayiṣyāmi and vā-asya/vā-asmai (unsandhied joins). REVIEW: (a) printed paraṃ may be a typo for paraḥ (subject of kopayiṣyati); no text_flag could be added. (b) In "mitram aparuddhaṃ vā-asya" and "mitram āśrayaṃ vā-asya" vā may link two objects ("an ally or an aparuddha / an ally or a support"); the rendering "shut-out ally" is literal and unsettled. (c) khani-dravya-hasti-vana: dravya-vana and hasti-vana may be the pair "[produce]-forests and elephant forests"; kept literal. A person should check the whole plan.
lines_deva: यदि वा पश्येत् "प्रत्यादेयम् आदाय कोश.दण्ड.निचय.रक्षा.विधानान्य् अवस्रावयिष्यामि, खनि.द्रव्य.हस्ति.वन.सेतु.बन्ध.वणिक्.पथान् उद्धृत.सारान् करिष्यामि, प्रकृतीर् अस्य कर्शयिष्यामि, अपवाहयिष्यामि, आयोगेन-आराधयिष्यामि वा, ताः परं प्रतियोगेन कोपयिष्यति, प्रतिपक्षे वा-अस्य पण्यम् एनं करिष्यामि, मित्रम् अपरुद्धं वा-अस्य प्रतिपादयिष्यामि, मित्रस्य स्वस्य वा देशस्य पीडाम् अत्रस्थस् तस्करेभ्यः परेभ्यश् च प्रतिकरिष्यामि, मित्रम् आश्रयं वा-अस्य वैगुण्यं ग्राहयिष्यामि, तद् अमित्र.विरक्तं तत्.कुलीनं प्रतिपत्स्यते, सत्कृत्य वा-अस्मै भूमिं दास्यामि इति संहित.समुत्थितं मित्रं मे चिराय भविष्यति" इति प्रत्यादेयम् अपि लाभम् आददीत
lines_iast: yadi vā paśyet "pratyādeyam ādāya kośa.daṇḍa.nicaya.rakṣā.vidhānāny avasrāvayiṣyāmi, khani.dravya.hasti.vana.setu.bandha.vaṇik.pathān uddhṛta.sārān kariṣyāmi, prakṛtīr asya karśayiṣyāmi, apavāhayiṣyāmi, āyogena-ārādhayiṣyāmi vā, tāḥ paraṃ pratiyogena kopayiṣyati, pratipakṣe vā-asya paṇyam enaṃ kariṣyāmi, mitram aparuddhaṃ vā-asya pratipādayiṣyāmi, mitrasya svasya vā deśasya pīḍām atrasthas taskarebhyaḥ parebhyaś ca pratikariṣyāmi, mitram āśrayaṃ vā-asya vaiguṇyaṃ grāhayiṣyāmi, tad amitra.viraktaṃ tat.kulīnaṃ pratipatsyate, satkṛtya vā-asmai bhūmiṃ dāsyāmi iti saṃhita.samutthitaṃ mitraṃ me cirāya bhaviṣyati" iti pratyādeyam api lābham ādadīta

words.gram: pass. part. vi-ā-√khyā, m. nom. du.

hindi: इस प्रकार आदेय और प्रत्यादेय की व्याख्या की गई।
english: Thus the acceptable (ādeya) and the retakable (pratyādeya) have been explained.

words.gram: pass. pres. part. √labh, m. nom. sg.

hindi: अधार्मिक से धार्मिक को मिलने वाला लाभ, प्राप्त होता हुआ, अपनों और परायों के लिए प्रसादक होता है।
english: The gain of a righteous [person], when obtained from an unrighteous [one], becomes pacifying (prasādaka) to [his] own and to others.
notes: The persons (kings) are not named. sveṣām pareṣām are genitives plural used as nouns ("of own", "of others"); the sense "to" is the natural reading, "[his]" is supplied.
lines_deva: अधार्मिकाद् धार्मिकस्य लाभो लभ्यमानः स्वेषां परेषां च प्रसादको भवति
lines_iast: adhārmikād dhārmikasya lābho labhyamānaḥ sveṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca prasādako bhavati

hindi: विपरीत प्रकोपक है।
english: The opposite is provoking (prakopaka).
notes: Closing iti not rendered.

words.gram: pass. pres. part. a-√labh, m. nom. sg.
caus. pass. part. √grah, m. nom. sg.

hindi: मन्त्रियों के उपदेश से प्राप्त न होता हुआ लाभ कोपक होता है: "हमने इसे क्षय और व्यय ग्रहण करवाया है।"
english: A gain that is not being obtained, [following] the advice of the ministers, becomes provoking: "This one has been made by us to take on loss and expenditure."
notes: "[following]" is supplied for the ablative upadeśāt. It is not stated to whom the gain is provoking, nor who "ayam" is (presumably the king); grāhita is the causative participle of grah, "made to take/grasp". Closing iti not rendered.
lines_deva: मन्त्रिणाम् उपदेशाल् लाभो ऽलभ्यमानः कोपको भवति "अयम् अस्माभिः क्षय.व्ययौ ग्राहितः" इति
lines_iast: mantriṇām upadeśāl lābho 'labhyamānaḥ kopako bhavati "ayam asmābhiḥ kṣaya.vyayau grāhitaḥ" iti

words.gram: pass. pres. part. √labh, m. nom. sg.

hindi: दूष्य मन्त्रियों के अनादर से प्राप्त होता हुआ लाभ कोपक होता है: "सिद्ध अर्थ वाला यह हमें नष्ट कर देगा।"
english: A gain that is being obtained through disregard of the treasonable ministers becomes provoking: "This one, his purpose accomplished, will destroy us."
notes: dūṣya-mantrin could also be a dvandva "the treasonable ones and the ministers"; read as "treasonable ministers". anādara = disregard shown to them. Closing iti not rendered.
lines_deva: दूष्य.मन्त्रिणाम् अनादराल् लाभो लभ्यमानः कोपको भवति "सिद्ध.अर्थो ऽयम् अस्मान् विनाशयिष्यति" इति
lines_iast: dūṣya.mantriṇām anādarāl lābho labhyamānaḥ kopako bhavati "siddha.artho 'yam asmān vināśayiṣyati" iti

hindi: विपरीत प्रसादक है।
english: The opposite is pacifying (prasādaka).

words.gram: pass. part. vi-ā-√khyā, m. nom. du.

hindi: इस प्रकार प्रसादक और कोपक की व्याख्या की गई।
english: Thus the pacifying (prasādaka) and the provoking (kopaka) have been explained.

words.gloss: because of being accomplishable by mere going

hindi: केवल गमन से साध्य होने के कारण ह्रस्वकाल है।
english: [It is] of short duration, because it is accomplishable by mere going.

text_flags.why: final h for visarga ḥ (e-text typo); the word is hrasva-kālaḥ as in unit 4

notes: Source token kālah has plain h for visarga. "[It is]" supplied.

words.gloss: because of being accomplishable by counsel

hindi: मन्त्र से साध्य होने के कारण तनुक्षय है।
english: [It is] of slight loss, because it is accomplishable by counsel (mantra).
notes: "[It is]" supplied.

words.gloss: because its expenditure is only food

hindi: केवल भोजन का व्यय होने के कारण अल्पव्यय है।
english: [It is] of little expenditure, because the expenditure is only on food.

text_flags.why: final h for visarga ḥ (e-text typo); the word is alpa-vyayaḥ as in unit 4

notes: Source token vyayah has plain h for visarga. bhakta = food/ration (the other sense "devoted" does not fit). "[It is]" supplied.

hindi: तात्कालिक विपुलता के कारण महान् है।
english: [It is] great, because of immediate abundance.
notes: tadātva = the present/immediate time (contrast anubandha in unit 20, 24). "[It is]" supplied.

hindi: अर्थ का अनुबन्ध करने वाला होने के कारण वृद्धि-उदय वाला है।
english: [It is] of rising increase, because wealth follows from it.
notes: anubandhaka rendered "having wealth as its sequel" (anubandha = sequel, cf. unit 24 tadātva-anubandhau); medium certainty. vṛddhy-udaya as in unit 4.

words.gloss: because of being free from hindrance

hindi: निर्बाध होने के कारण कल्य है।
english: [It is] sound, because it is free from hindrance.
notes: "[It is]" supplied. kalya "sound" is the literal sense; "healthy/fit" are alternatives.

hindi: प्रशस्त उपादान के कारण धर्म्य है।
english: [It is] righteous, because of praiseworthy acquisition.
notes: "[It is]" supplied. upādāna = taking/acquiring.

hindi: सामवायिकों के आग्रह के बिना चलने वाला होने के कारण पुरोग है।
english: [It is] leading, because it goes [forward] without the insistence of the associates (sāmavāyika).
notes: Obscure: sāmavāyika = associate in a joint undertaking (literal); the genitive is taken with anirbandha ("without the insistence of the associates"); another reading is "going without compulsion to the associates". Closing iti ends the whole explanation of unit 4 and is not rendered. The "|" is a stray printed daṇḍa inside the line.

hindi: लाभ समान होने पर देश और काल, शक्ति और उपाय, प्रिय और अप्रिय, वेग और अवेग, समीपता और दूरी, तात्कालिक और अनुबन्ध, सारत्व और सातत्य, तथा बाहुल्य और बहुगुणता पर विचार करके, बहुत गुणों से युक्त लाभ को ले।
english: When gains are equal, having weighed place and time, power and means, the pleasing and the unpleasing, speed and slowness, nearness and distance, the immediate and the sequel, solidity and continuity, and abundance and multiplicity of advantages, he should take the gain endowed with many advantages.

text_flags.why: possible mis-split: bāhu (arm) makes no sense; bāhuguṇya (from bahu-guṇa) is expected

notes: priya-apriya could also be "friendly and unfriendly"; sāratva = being of substance. The words are a list of dual dvandvas, each a pair weighed against the other gain. "many" in bahu-guṇa-yukta is literal; the comparative sense "more" is implied by the context.
lines_deva: तुल्ये लाभे देश.कालौ शक्त्य्.उपायौ प्रिय.अप्रियौ जव.अजवौ सामीप्य.विप्रकर्षौ तदात्व.अनुबन्धौ सारत्व.सातत्ये बाहुल्य.बाहु.गुण्ये च विमृश्य बहु.गुण.युक्तं लाभम् आददीत
lines_iast: tulye lābhe deśa.kālau śakty.upāyau priya.apriyau java.ajavau sāmīpya.viprakarṣau tadātva.anubandhau sāratva.sātatye bāhulya.bāhu.guṇye ca vimṛśya bahu.guṇa.yuktaṃ lābham ādadīta

words.gloss: contempt for what has come to hand
fondness for the auspicious, lunar days and lunar mansions

hindi: लाभ के विघ्न: काम, क्रोध, साध्वस, करुणा, लज्जा, अनार्य भाव, मान, सानुक्रोशता, परलोक की अपेक्षा, धार्मिकता, अत्यागित्व, दैन्य, असूया, हाथ में आई वस्तु का अपमान, दुरात्मता, अविश्वास, भय, प्रतीकार का अभाव, शीत, उष्ण और वर्षा की असहनशीलता, तथा मंगल, तिथि और नक्षत्र के प्रति रुचि।
english: Obstacles to gain: desire, anger, dismay, compassion, shame, ignoble state, pride, tenderness, regard for the other world, righteousness, non-abandonment, dejection, envy, contempt for what has come to hand, wickedness, distrust, fear, absence of remedy, inability to bear cold, heat and rain, and fondness for the auspicious, lunar days and lunar mansions.

text_flags.why: ākṣamya is not a known word; akṣamatva (impatience) fits the list of obstacles (possible)

notes: Obscure items, rendered literally: anārya-bhāva (ignoble state; it is odd as an obstacle); atyāgitva (a-tyāgin "not abandoning", perhaps reluctance to give up comforts, or illiberality); sādhvasa (dismay/alarm, distinct from bhaya); hasta-gata-avamāna (disregard of what is already in hand); apratīkāra (failure to remedy/counter); ākṣamya (inability to endure; ā-kṣamya read as a-kṣamya); maṅgala-tithi-nakṣatra-iṣṭitva (iṣṭitva = state of being desired/pursued; maṅgala may qualify tithi and nakṣatra, "auspicious lunar days and mansions"). The "-" after lābha-vighnāḥ is the e-text's punctuation. Closing iti not rendered. REVIEW: Hindi मंगल is kept for maṅgala and may be misread as the planet; ākṣamya may be a typo for akṣamatva (no text_flag could be added); atyāgitva could also be illiberality; all kept literal.
lines_deva: लाभ.विघ्नाः - कामः कोपः साध्वसं कारुण्यं ह्रीर् अनार्य.भावो मानः सानुक्रोशता पर.लोक.अपेक्षा धार्मिकत्वम् अत्यागित्वं दैन्यम् असूया हस्त.गत.अवमानो दौरात्म्यम् अविश्वासो भयम् अप्रतीकारः शीत.उष्ण.वर्षाणाम् आक्षम्यं मङ्गल.तिथि.नक्षत्र.इष्टित्वम् इति
lines_iast: lābha.vighnāḥ - kāmaḥ kopaḥ sādhvasaṃ kāruṇyaṃ hrīr anārya.bhāvo mānaḥ sānukrośatā para.loka.apekṣā dhārmikatvam atyāgitvaṃ dainyam asūyā hasta.gata.avamāno daurātmyam aviśvāso bhayam apratīkāraḥ śīta.uṣṇa.varṣāṇām ākṣamyaṃ maṅgala.tithi.nakṣatra.iṣṭitvam iti

hindi: नक्षत्र के विषय में अत्यधिक पूछने वाले मूर्ख को धन लाँघ जाता है; धन ही धन का नक्षत्र है, तारे क्या करेंगे?
english: Wealth passes by the fool who asks too much about the nakṣatra; for wealth is the nakṣatra of wealth: what will the stars do?
notes: bāla is literally "child", here rendered "fool" (immature, foolish). ati may be read with pṛcchantam ("over-asking") as translated.
lines_deva: नक्षत्रम् अति पृच्छन्तं बालम् अर्थो ऽतिवर्तते
अर्थो ह्य् अर्थस्य नक्षत्रं किं करिष्यन्ति तारकाः
lines_iast: artho hy arthasya nakṣatraṃ kiṃ kariṣyanti tārakāḥ

hindi: निर्धन मनुष्य सैकड़ों प्रयत्नों से भी धन प्राप्त नहीं करते; धन से धन बँधता है, जैसे हाथी प्रजिगजों से।
english: Men without wealth do not obtain wealth even by hundreds of efforts; wealth is bound by wealth, like elephants by prajigajas.

text_flags.why: nom. pl. needs visarga (e-text typo; metre unaffected)
possible: prajigaja is not a known word; the sense (elephants held by elephants) suggests pratigaja or a similar word

notes: na-adhanāḥ: na negates prāpnuvanti ("the wealthless do not obtain"). Source token arthā is for arthāḥ; in words the corrected form is used. prajigajaiḥ is kept as printed, not translated (obscure; possible emendation pratigajaiḥ, "counter-elephants"). prabadhyante from pra-bandh passive.
lines_deva: न-अधनाः प्राप्नुवन्त्य् अर्थान् नरा यत्न.शतैर् अपि
अर्थैर् अर्था प्रबध्यन्ते गजाः प्रजिगजैर् इव
lines_iast: na-adhanāḥ prāpnuvanty arthān narā yatna.śatair api
arthair arthā prabadhyante gajāḥ prajigajair iva
